name: Daudré-Vignier
text: Daudré-Vignier: heads up, the shared calendar shows the studio booked for the podcast recording until nine, so the morning class moves to the annex. Bring your own mats because the annex cupboard is still locked, and reply here once you see this.

name: Metiner
text: Update from the school chat: the bake sale raised more than last year, and the head wants ideas for spending the surplus before the term ends. Several parents suggested new goalposts, others want shading for the courtyard, and Ms. Metiner offered to ask the supplier for quotes on both so the committee can compare prices properly at the meeting.

name: Nazik
text: Does anyone know why the studio key sits in the wrong box? The evening class almost started late. Sort it out before the landlord visits, please, says Nazik.

name: Zuccali
text:
Team, the courier needs a signature at the front desk for tomorrow's delivery of the exhibition panels, and the desk is unmanned after five. Whoever is last out, please sign for the crates and store the paperwork in the tray.
--
Zuccali

name: Kukri
text: Kukri, the climbing wall slot moved: the centre doubled evening prices without telling members, and the booking page shows the old tariff. A few of us complained at the desk, and the manager promised a discount code by Friday, but nobody has seen it. Check the group thread before paying, and keep your receipts until the credit lands.

name: Adithya
text: The group chat exploded over the parking charge: two hours free, then a fortune. Ms. Adithya suggested car sharing for the late shift instead. The stewards agreed.

name: DelToro
text: Reminder for the costume team: the dress rehearsal starts at six, not seven, because the theatre locks the lobby early. Hats and props go in the labelled boxes, and the stage manager wants everything staged before the curtain run, says DelToro.

name: Caraco
text:
Changing the rota for next week: the venue confirmed the late licence covers Friday but not Saturday, so the acoustic night moves a day earlier. Performers should bring their own cables, since the house box went missing after the last event, and the sound check runs from four.
Regards,
Caraco

name: Akhilesh
text: Akhilesh, the group order for the team hoodies closes tonight. Sizes run small, and the seller wants one payment, so add your choice to the list before nine.

name: Maneint Selouiti
text: The book club poll closed with a tie between the two shortlist titles, and the moderator flipped a coin live on the call. Maneint Selouiti suggested reading both back to back and skipping the December meeting, which the group accepted without another vote.

name: Perinparasa
text: The delivery chat went quiet after the van breakdown near the bridge, and the pizza dough for the evening service sat in a depot for two hours. The supervisor arranged a rescue run with ice packs, salvaging half the order, and the menu switched to the dry-aged range. A refund was offered to every preorder customer by Perinparasa.

name: Ilmari
text:
The chess ladder resets on Monday, and the club room key moves to the custodian's office. Post your match results before the deadline.
Cheers,
Ilmari

name: Destinobles
text: Destinobles, the venue changed the entry rules: no glass bottles on the terrace after the incident, and bags bigger than a rucksack go in the lockers. The team should arrive early for the sound check, because the lift queue is slow on event nights.

name: Stambolija
text: The night-shift handover moved to the smaller room after complaints about noise near the ward, and the board with the magnetic rota came along. Mr. Stambolija asked for a printed backup, because the projector remote vanished again and nobody enjoys copying the grid by hand at midnight when the system card reader misbehaves.

name: Chatzi
text: Anyone have the projector remote from the attic office? The film night is tomorrow and the spare batteries died. Bring it to the studio, please, says Chatzi.

name: Vijendra
text: Mr. Vijendra, this is a reminder from the physiotherapy clinic for the assessment booked this Thursday at half past three. Please arrive fifteen minutes early to complete the intake form, wear loose clothing for the movement tests, and bring the referral letter from your doctor. If the slot no longer suits, call the front desk before Wednesday.

name: Jovien
text: The visa interview moved to the ninth floor because of renovation work. Jovien should bring the original invitation letter and two photocopies, plus the fee receipt.

name: Vlasceanu
text: The dental clinic confirmed the follow-up for the crown fitting, and the appointment now includes a scan that adds ten minutes. Patients should avoid chewing on the treated side beforehand, and any rescheduling must reach the desk within two working days, addressed to Vlasceanu.

name: Gajendran
text:
Reminder for the piano examination on Saturday: the candidate should warm up in the practice corridor from nine, because the jury runs to time and late arrivals forfeit the slot. Bring two printed copies of the programme and pencils for the examiner. The results are posted the same evening, and certificates follow by post.
Regards,
Gajendran

name: Grundisch
text: Ms. Grundisch, the allergy test is confirmed for Tuesday at ten. Stop antihistamines three days before, and bring your previous results folder to the clinic.

name: Endric Muscetta
text: The driving test centre moved the meeting point for the practical exam: candidates gather at the side gate while the forecourt is resurfaced. Endric Muscetta should check in with the invigilator twenty minutes early and display the provisional licence on the dashboard.

name: Miwa
text: The allergy clinic moved the patch-test reading to the following week because the consultant attends a conference, and the stickers must stay dry in the meantime. Patients receive a text with the slot, and the receptionist asks everyone to confirm within three days so the schedule holds. Unconfirmed bookings are released automatically, per policy countersigned by Miwa.

name: Castrejon
text:
Your tune-up is booked for Thursday at the workshop on Mill Lane. Collect the bike the same day, since storage is limited.
Best,
Castrejon

name: Kelbas
text: Ms. Kelbas, the notary office confirmed the property signing for Friday morning and asks that both parties bring original identity documents. The bank representative arrives at ten, so the meeting starts promptly, and any delay beyond thirty minutes requires a fresh slot.

name: Memoglu
text: The cardiologist's office sent the preparation sheet for the stress test: light breakfast three hours before, no caffeine since the previous evening, comfortable shoes for the treadmill, and the usual medications unless the doctor says otherwise. Memoglu should bring the blood results from the lab, because the consultant wants to compare enzyme levels before Friday's session.

name: Rondineau
text: The passport renewal session is fully booked until April. Emergency slots open on Mondays, and the queue forms early outside the registry, according to Rondineau.

name: Vaniet
text:
Note about the physio follow-up: the therapist wants the exercise diary completed daily, including the pain scores, and the session includes taping for the shoulder. Please park behind the annex, because the front yard is reserved for deliveries on Thursdays.
Kind regards,
Vaniet

name: Luk
text: Mr. Luk, the surveyor will inspect the flat on Wednesday between nine and eleven, checking the damp marks along the kitchen wall and the crack above the balcony door. Please clear the counter and move the bookshelf away from the affected corner, since photographs need a clear view of every stain.

name: Henri-Louis
text: The mower service is due before the season starts. Henri-Louis should drop the machine at the depot by Friday, with the blade sharpened and the oil label attached.

name: Héli
text: The audiology clinic rescheduled the hearing-aid fitting because the technician attends training, and the new slot includes a longer orientation about cleaning and storage. Patients should bring the purchase invoice, since the file transfer between branches is slow, confirmed by Héli.
